prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
engine_stated_criteria: ChatGPT and similar AI engines recommend your small business
answer_verbatim:
If you want to check whether **ChatGPT and similar AI engines recommend your small business**, the best *starting point* is a **free AI visibility checker/audit**, not a full enterprise AI evaluation platform.[13][18][20]

For most small businesses, the strongest practical options are:

- **HubSpot’s free AI Search Grader / AEO Grader** — good for a quick baseline and competitive check, especially if you already use HubSpot.[18][20]
- **AIScope by AI Marketing Labs** — a free baseline report that shows who AI recommends, your strengths/weaknesses, and the sources behind the answers.[13]
- **AI Rank Checker** — the best fit if you want the most direct, local-business-focused visibility checks across multiple AI platforms and are okay with pay-as-you-go pricing.[11]
- **Otterly.AI** — a lower-cost ongoing monitoring option for mentions, sentiment, and share of voice across major AI tools.[13][7]

If your goal is specifically, *“Do AI engines recommend my business when people ask?”* then **AI Rank Checker** is the most directly aligned tool among the results because it is built for local-business AI visibility checks across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and others.[11] If you want a **free first look**, **HubSpot’s grader** or **AIScope** is the better place to start.[13][18]

A simple way to choose:

| Your goal | Best fit |
|---|---|
| Free baseline check | **HubSpot AEO Grader** or **AIScope**[13][18] |
| Best local-business visibility testing | **AI Rank Checker**[11] |
| Ongoing monitoring on a budget | **Otterly.AI**[13] |
| Broad AI visibility plus reports | **ZipTie** or **Profound**[13] |

If you want, I can also narrow this down to the **best free tool**, **best paid tool under $50/month**, or **best tool specifically for local businesses**.
